Bulbous_Periscope_Eyes.description: Massive, independently rotating eyes that sit completely atop the skull. They provide nearly 360-degree vision and can remain safely above the waterline while the rest of the body is totally submerged.

Nictitating_Aquatic_Lenses.description: Standard vertebrate eyes equipped with a heavily specialized, transparent third eyelid (nictitating membrane) that acts like built-in biological goggles, polarizing light and protecting the cornea while navigating turbid underwater environments.
